definitions.explanation: A narrow piece of land that extends into a body of water.

examples.japanese: {岬|みさき}の{先端|せんたん}に{灯台|とうだい}がある。
examples.english: There's a lighthouse at the tip of the cape.

examples.japanese: {岬|みさき}から{海|うみ}を{見渡|みわた}す。
examples.english: Look out over the sea from the cape.

examples.japanese: {知床岬|しれとこみさき}は{世界遺産|せかいいさん}に{登録|とうろく}されている。
examples.english: Cape Shiretoko is registered as a World Heritage site.

notes:
{岬|みさき} refers to a point of land extending into water.

FAMOUS CAPES IN JAPAN:
- {知床岬|しれとこみさき} (Cape Shiretoko, Hokkaido)
- {潮岬|しおのみさき} (Cape Shiono, southernmost point of Honshu)
- {足摺岬|あしずりみさき} (Cape Ashizuri, Shikoku)
- {佐多岬|さたみさき} (Cape Sata, southernmost point of Kyushu)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {岬|みさき}を{回|まわ}る (to go around a cape)
- {岬|みさき}の{先端|せんたん} (tip of the cape)
